description: Source code for handling CSV import operations in a web server context, including parsing SQL COPY statements, executing CSV imports into PostgreSQL or other databases, and managing CSV reading and processing.
external_files: sqlparser::ast::{CopyLegacyCsvOption, CopyLegacyOption, CopyOption, CopySource, CopyTarget, Statement}
sqlx::{any::{AnyArguments, AnyConnectionKind, AnyKind}, AnyConnection, Arguments, Executor, PgConnection}

classes.name: CsvImport
classes.description: Struct representing CSV import configuration and metadata for database import operations.

methods.name: extract_csv_copy_statement
methods.description: Parses a SQL COPY statement to extract CSV import parameters.

methods.name: run_csv_import
methods.description: Executes CSV import based on the provided CsvImport configuration, handling PostgreSQL and other database types.

methods.name: run_csv_import_postgres
methods.description: Performs a fast CSV import directly into PostgreSQL using COPY FROM STDIN.

methods.name: run_csv_import_insert
methods.description: Performs CSV import into non-PostgreSQL databases by reading CSV records and executing INSERT statements.

methods.name: compute_column_indices
methods.description: Determines column indices in CSV based on header row or column order.

methods.name: create_insert_stmt
methods.description: Generates an SQL INSERT statement for the target table and columns.

methods.name: process_csv_record
methods.description: Processes a single CSV record and executes an insert into the database.

methods.name: make_csv_reader
methods.description: Creates a CSV reader configured with delimiters, quotes, headers, and escape characters.
